title: Hot Grilled Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A salty, molten, and indulgent Thai dish featuring pineapple juice, perfect for a raw-friendly meal, originating from the Isaan region of Thailand, this recipe combines the sweetness of pineapple with the spiciness of Thai chilies.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, grated ginger, Thai red chili peppers, and garlic.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with sliced pineapple and fresh cilantro.
Offer steamed jasmine rice or noodles on the side to complete the meal.
